ref_text: The kettle had boiled twice before anyone noticed. Outside, the rain kept on, steady and grey, and the bus was late again.

lines.text: Your partner in crime is in the next room.
The other one does ten years.
Both of you talk? Five each.
If nobody talks, a year each.
I'd bet ten years on it.
If you stayed silent, you both do a year.
If you talked, you walk out tonight, and he does the ten.
It doesn't need a bad friend.
It just needs you to doubt a good one.
Now try it on your partner in crime.
Unless they just tried it on you.
